CustomField.description: The Transaction this wire belongs to, for acquisition earnest-money and closing wires. ADDITIVE: the existing Disposition__c lookup, the six verification evidence fields and the Verified_DateTime_Not_Backdatable rule are untouched, and a wire carries one parent or the other, never both. SAFE AGAINST THE DISPOSITION SIDE: relationshipName is unique per TARGET object, so Wires here does not collide with the Wires relationship Disposition__c already uses. The Wire_Verification_Rollup flow filters on Disposition__c not null, so a Transaction-parented wire never enters it - verify that filter by readback after any change to that flow.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The deal this wire belongs to. Leave blank on disposition wires, which use the Disposition field instead.
CustomField.label: Transaction
